review_proposals.title: Mismatch-aware completion gate
review_proposals.what_to_build: When the agent claims completion, inspect its most recent check for an unambiguous nonzero exit or explicit mismatch. If found, bounce the claim once with the existing evidence; do not require another check when none has failed.
review_proposals.why: Failed trajectories often ended with a completion claim despite the agent’s own check showing an error or difference. The current gate catches missing checks, not ignored results.
review_proposals.how_to_test: Run a separate paired arm against v0. Measure pass rate, false_success, turns_after_gate, timeouts, and the fraction of bounces followed by a successful correction. Audit bounced cases for false positives.
review_proposals.risk: A legitimate or already-resolved error could be mistaken for a current failure; even targeted bounces consume scarce time.

review_proposals.title: Do not count an echoed success message as a check
review_proposals.what_to_build: Change the existing completion gate so a command that merely prints a success message does not satisfy its check requirement; retain the one-bounce limit.
review_proposals.why: Echoing completion instead of checking is common in failed trials, and the current gate did not reduce it. This needs command-aware code, not a candidate configuration.
review_proposals.how_to_test: Evaluate separately from the mismatch gate against v0; compare echo_theater, pass rate, turns_after_gate, and timeouts, and manually inspect commands excluded from counting.
review_proposals.risk: A broad detector could exclude legitimate checks or add turns without enabling the model to fix the work.
